items.title: 63477_Joe Darensbourg oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] I mean Sonny Clay. They recorded a thing called "Sheffield Blues." ... [INTERVIEWEE] No, it must have been named after Officer Sheffield.

ctx.x: I mean Sonny Clay. They recorded a thing called "Sheffield Blues." And everybody was trying to think, "Where is this Sheffield? Was it named after the town of Sheffield somewhere, or..."
No, it must have been named after Officer Sheffield.
